scope: Full r=2t core and all-input theorem for odd t>=3, 3t<=p follows from written proof and stated Morris/Serre dependencies. Finite checks do not prove infinite group containment or compile arbitrary principal matrices to short physical words.

all_interior_extension.scope: All odd t>=3 with 2t<=p-3, not just 3t<=p. Principal subgroup and finite-to-exact inverse lifting use the existing stated Morris/Serre dependencies.
